race.comment: SAVOONGA (11) has made a real statement in her last two with arrogant wins after just missing first-up at Newy. She's in red-hot touch, keeps Lloyd, and while the draw is sticky, she has the right rider to manage it. THINK ITZ YOU (7) found the promising Mr Miller here first up when only warming into it late. The rise in trip second up looks perfect and McDonald is a key switch. Expect a bold showing. LEICA STORM (3) has good early speed and should take full advantage of the low draw. She strips fitter third up and if left alone through the middle stages she'll take plenty of reeling in. MOTOSCAFO (9) has mixed her form this prep but closed strongly into third at Rosehill last time. A repeat of that effort puts her right in this. FLYING FROM ABOVE (6) drops back to the mile after being reeled in by Concordia Wind over 1900m at Rosehill. She gets in well with the 3kg claim and is worth keeping safe.
